segments.title: Cold Open & Hype Train Derailment
segments.notes: Pepito delivers station sign-on; Hype Train commandeers broadcast with extended freestyle rap about piss, shit, crack, diapers, and toilets being adult diapers.

segments.title: AI Slop Check-In: Brother's Generative Videos
segments.notes: Case reviews AI-generated videos from his brother's account including cheese-themed clips, Dracula, Puffy Baron, and prison BTS; hits personal limit around 10 videos.

segments.title: Gaza Ceasefire Deal & Chicago National Guard Deployment
segments.notes: Reuters report on Israel-Hamas ceasefire/hostage deal; Trump claims credit, Nobel Prize speculation; Pete Hegseth deploys Texas National Guard to Chicago; Rick and Case debate 'Meal Team 6' nicknames and antifa designation.

segments.title: Town Hall: Pepito & Sentient Cheese Block
segments.notes: Pepito and a talking block of cheese take chat questions via !TH; cheese claims cosmic memory from Big Bang, Pepito admits cheese is narcotic, Pepito eats cheese at conclusion.

segments.title: Chat News with Grandma Crumble Bottom
segments.notes: Grandma Crumble Bottom (witch form) joins; stories include Korean streamer murder, YouTube second chance program, Luna cloud gaming, Hassan dog shock collar controversy, Jennifer Lopez surgery, bear attacks, OpenAI chip deal, Ubisoft Assassin's Creed cancellation, penis ring medical emergency, Palisades fire arson arrest, Tesla Optimus robot at Tron premiere.

segments.title: Crumb and Ash Hole: Immortality Debate
segments.notes: Crum argues for immortality via Chinese stem therapy/robot bodies; Munch defends death as natural; Crum reveals horns growing from allergic reaction to wife's sheets, marital strain, wife allegedly married to Gizmo.

segments.title: DJ C4: Justin Juice Powers UK Grime Theme (Part 1)
segments.notes: DJ C4 and ghostwriter construct UK street rap beat and lyrics for Justin Juice Powers theme; includes 'fuckabogic' chorus, Spruce Goose rhymes, South Hampton area code; session runs long, continued Friday.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered the Gaza ceasefire agreement and Texas National Guard deployment to Chicago before descending into a town hall where Pepito consumed a sentient cheese block claiming Big Bang memories. Crum and Munch debated immortality, revealing Crum's celestial horn growth and marital collapse, while DJ C4 began a two-session UK grime theme production for Justin Juice Powers that will conclude Friday.
